content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause \"The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables.\", this allows for an excessive amount of work; I propose changing this so that The parties agree to include up to two (2) rounds of revisions for each principal Deliverable. - Regarding the clause \"Invoices are payable Net 60.\", waiting two months to get paid harms my cash flow; I propose changing this to Invoices are payable Net 30. - Regarding the clause \"Revision allowance: 15 rounds\", this is excessively high and can trap me in endless iterations; I propose changing this to Revision allowance: 3 rounds. - Regarding the clause \"Payment period: Net 60\", waiting 60 days strains my cash flow; I propose changing this to Payment period: Net 30. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can finalize the agreement. Best regards,
